Sukrit Sen:- https://www.instagram.com/suku.mama

In this vlog, we take you through Durga Puja in Kolkata, a nine-day celebration of faith, food, art and togetherness, and shares what the experience meant to him.

Ranveer shares his experiences from pandal hopping and the artistry of the festival to Bengali food and celebrating with friends. He explains why Durga Puja feels like home to him.

He also explores rituals like dhunuchi dance and sindoor khela, along with a deeply emotional aarti moment that left him grateful for the blessings in his life. Along the way, he shares unforgettable experiences from the celebrations.

If you are interested in Durga Puja, Kolkata travel, Bengali culture, pandal hopping, Bengali food, Navratri, Indian festivals, spirituality and gratitude, this vlog is for you.

#durgapuja    #navratri
